display.purpose: Home wordmark only — the largest type on the site, JetBrains Mono.

title.purpose: Snippet name at the top of a detail page.

heading.purpose: Section headers (Preview/Props/API/Usage), ruled with a hairline rather than scaled up.

body.purpose: Running prose in Hanken Grotesk; capped near 58–75ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono micro-type — categories, kinds, table heads, TOC title.

extensions.shadowPhilosophy: Flat by construction. No box-shadows anywhere in site chrome. Depth = tonal layering (inset < canvas < surface < surface-raised) + 1px hairlines + backdrop-filter blur(10px) on sticky chrome only. Glow belongs to snippet previews, never the frame.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default for color/background/border state transitions on links, buttons, rows.

motion.name: index-nudge
motion.purpose: The snippet-index row shifts right ~0.35rem on hover — the terminal-cursor tell.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — crossfade or instant; never gate content visibility on a transition.
motion.purpose: Required fallback; animated effects are core content so motion is honored, not removed.

breakpoints.name: docs-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Detail page drops the right-hand On-This-Page TOC; docs grid becomes single-column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one place the amber accent is a surface. Browse / primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--color-accent, #f5b544); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #1a1206); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent2, #ffc65a); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-fg, #f4f4f5); border: 1px solid var(--color-line2, #34343f); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #151519); }

components.name: Nav Wordmark
components.description: Brand mark — tskr in ink, /ui in filament amber.
components.css: .ds-brand { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--color-fg, #f4f4f5); text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand span { color: var(--color-accent, #f5b544); }

components.name: Sidebar Link (active)
components.description: Active docs sidebar item — amber wash, never a side stripe.
components.css: .ds-side-link { display: block; padding: 0.38rem 0.6rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--color-muted, #b4b4bc); text-decoration: none; } .ds-side-link:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #151519); color: var(--color-fg, #f4f4f5); } .ds-side-link[aria-current="true"] { color: var(--color-accent, #f5b544); background: var(--color-accent-soft, rgba(245,181,68,0.12)); }

components.name: Snippet Index Row
components.description: Home index — a typographic mono path, not a card. Hover nudges the row right (terminal-cursor tell).
components.css: .ds-index-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.25rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-fg, #f4f4f5); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, padding-left 0.2s ease; } .ds-index-path { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-index-path em { font-style: normal; color: var(--color-dim, #8a8a93); } .ds-index-kind { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-dim, #8a8a93); } .ds-index-item:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #151519); color: var(--color-accent, #f5b544); padding-left: 0.6rem; } .ds-index-item:hover .ds-index-path em { color: var(--color-accent, #f5b544); }

components.name: Preview Stage
components.description: The lit cutout a snippet renders into — recessed (darker than canvas), hairline border, faint dot-grid. The chrome recedes; the snippet is the loud thing.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 12rem; padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-inset, #0a0a0c); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #26262e); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 8px); background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 1px, transparent 0); background-size: 22px 22px; }

narrative.overview: tskr/ui is a copy-paste UI library, and its site is a dev console you read code in — charcoal everywhere, one warm amber accent, monospace-forward type. The binding constraint (ADR-0008): the chrome must recede so snippet previews are the loud thing. Previews are often cool, glowy, animated; the warm, quiet chrome is chosen so those cool previews pop against it. The chrome is the matte frame; the user's snippet is the artwork. It explicitly rejects the React Bits identity it sits closest to — cool violet, purple gradients, decorative glow, Geist — and the bg-neutral-950/Inter AI-SaaS scaffold.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace carries headings and wordmarks; the terminal cue is the brand.
Flat by construction — depth is tonal layering + 1px hairlines, never shadow.
One accent, used to point — never to decorate.
Tight radii (4/6/8px). Nothing soft or pill-shaped.

rules.name: The One Filament Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only chromatic color in the site chrome. It appears on a small fraction of any screen and always to point — active state, name, brand mark, primary action. The moment amber decorates rather than guides, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Lit-Cutout Rule
rules.body: The preview stage is the one surface darker than the canvas (inset #0a0a0c) so the snippet reads as lit. Chrome goes up the tonal ramp; the content well goes down.

rules.name: The Mono-Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings and wordmarks are monospace, not the body sans. Size and a hairline underline carry hierarchy — heads are mono and ruled, not dramatically larger. This is what makes the page read as a terminal.

rules.name: The Restrained-Scale Rule
rules.body: Display tops out at ~3rem. The site never shouts with type; a heading that needs to be louder is wrong about its hierarchy, not its size.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows are forbidden in site chrome. A surface that needs to feel raised goes up the tonal ramp or gains a hairline — never a shadow. Glow belongs to snippet previews, never the frame.

dos: Do keep the canvas charcoal (#0e0e11) and the accent the single warm Filament Amber (#f5b544). One voice.
Do reach for monospace (JetBrains Mono) for headings, wordmarks, labels, and code-adjacent UI.
Do convey depth with tonal layering and 1px hairlines, not shadow.
Do let the preview stage go darker than the canvas (inset #0a0a0c) so the snippet reads as lit.
Do keep radii tight (4/6/8px) and text near-white (#f4f4f5), never pure #fff, never pill-shaped.
Do keep body text on Muted (#b4b4bc) or brighter and cap prose near 58–75ch; Muted and Dim are AA-tuned on the canvas.
donts: Don't adopt the React Bits identity: cool violet, purple-to-blue gradients, decorative glow, Geist.
Don't ship the bg-neutral-950 / text-neutral-100 AI-SaaS scaffold with Inter/Geist.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), the hero-metric template, glassmorphism as decoration, or identical icon-card grids.
Don't add drop shadows to site chrome; glow belongs to snippet previews.
Don't use a colored left/right border as a stripe accent on cards, list items, or callouts. The only sanctioned left border is the inert 2px TOC reading rail.
Don't let amber decorate — if it isn't pointing at an active state, name, brand mark, or primary action, it doesn't belong.
Don't make headings dramatically large to signal hierarchy; mono weight + a hairline underline carry it.
